## Summary

Describe the change and the user-visible behavior it affects.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit tests pass with `pytest -c pytest.ini -v`.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_code.py` passes.
- [ ] Distribution checks pass when packaging behavior changed.
- [ ] Live-SAS integration testing was run or is documented as an external gate.

## Documentation

- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` were updated when public behavior changed.
- [ ] No credentials, SAS configuration files, proprietary code, or SAS JARs are included.
